short_description:
GTA 6's criminal profile tracks how you commit crimes, a bit like Red Dead 2's honor. Four levels: Professional, Aggressive, Violent, Psycho, and Jason and Lucia each have their own. Push it too far and it can shatter (some guides say Irredeemable): locked for the rest of the game. To bring it back, cut the unnecessary violence: clean getaways, no extra kills. Full guide: vicereplay.com (Guides). No story spoilers.

Sources: PC Gamer, GamesRadar, Notebookcheck, GTABase, Insider Gaming.

facts_note: Nov 24 (search gap 'gta 6 how to lower criminal profile'): tracks HOW you commit crimes, RDR2-honor-like (PC Gamer, GamesRadar, Destructoid); separate profiles for Jason and Lucia (Notebookcheck + others); four levels Professional/Aggressive/Violent/Psycho (GTABase 'professional to psycho', Beebom, others; one guide says 'Hardened'); a fifth broken state, 'Shattered' (PC Gamer) or 'Irredeemable' (some guides), permanent (Notebookcheck, Dexerto 'gives up on you'): both names stated. Lower it by cutting unnecessary violence (GTABase, Insider Gaming, guides; Rob Nelson reportedly: it shifts when you consistently go beyond what's necessary). What each level changes in play isn't settled: left out. Re-check right before posting.
